name: ECE 4111
title: Communication Systems
description: Communication of information over noisy channels. Fourier transform review, spectral analysis, and sampling. Amplitude, phase, and frequency modulation of a sinusoidal carrier. Time and frequency division multiplexing. Random processes and analysis of communication of systems in noise. Elements of digital communication systems.
requirement_description: ECE 3101 or BME 3400; STAT 3345Q or MATH 3160; open only to students in the School of Engineering.
